    # Parse a string to a Liquid Condition
    def parse_condition(exp)
      parser    = Liquid::Parser.new(exp)
      condition = parse_binary_comparison(parser)

      parser.consume(:end_of_string)
      condition
    end

    # Generate a Liquid::Condition object from a Liquid::Parser object additionally processing
    # the parsed expression based on whether the expression consists of binary operations with
    # Liquid operators `and` or `or`
    #
    #  - parser: an instance of Liquid::Parser
    #
    # Returns an instance of Liquid::Condition
    def parse_binary_comparison(parser)
      parse_one_comparison = lambda do
        left_markup = parser.expression
        prepared_left = Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_lookup_markup(left_markup)
        left_kind = Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_fragment_kind(prepared_left)
        left_operand = nil
        if left_kind == :literal
          left_operand = Liquid::Expression::LITERALS[prepared_left]
        elsif left_kind == :quoted
          if prepared_left.start_with?("'")
            prepared_left =~ Liquid::Expression::SINGLE_QUOTED_STRING
            left_operand = Regexp.last_match(1)
          else
            prepared_left =~ Liquid::Expression::DOUBLE_QUOTED_STRING
            left_operand = Regexp.last_match(1)
          end
        elsif left_kind == :integer
          if prepared_left.start_with?("-")
            prepared_left =~ Liquid::Expression::INTEGERS_REGEX
            left_operand = Regexp.last_match(1).to_i
          else
            prepared_left =~ Liquid::Expression::INTEGERS_REGEX
            left_operand = Regexp.last_match(1).to_i
          end
        elsif left_kind == :range
          prepared_left =~ Liquid::Expression::RANGES_REGEX
          range_start = Regexp.last_match(1)
          range_end = Regexp.last_match(2)
          start_markup = range_start
          end_markup = range_end
          if Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_fragment_kind(range_start) == :identifier
            start_markup = Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_lookup_markup(range_start)
          end
          if Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_fragment_kind(range_end) == :identifier
            end_markup = Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_lookup_markup(range_end)
          end
          left_operand = Liquid::RangeLookup.parse(start_markup, end_markup)
        elsif left_kind == :float
          if prepared_left.start_with?("-")
            prepared_left =~ Liquid::Expression::FLOATS_REGEX
            left_operand = Regexp.last_match(1).to_f
          else
            prepared_left =~ Liquid::Expression::FLOATS_REGEX
            left_operand = Regexp.last_match(1).to_f
          end
        elsif prepared_left.include?(".")
          segments = prepared_left.split(".")
          rebuilt_segments = []
          index = 0
          while index < segments.length
            segment = segments[index]
            if index.zero?
              rebuilt_segments << Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.canonical_condition_token(segment)
            else
              if segment.include?("[")
                rebuilt_segments << Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.canonical_condition_token(segment)
              else
                rebuilt_segments << Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.canonical_condition_token(segment)
              end
            end
            index += 1
          end
          left_operand = Liquid::VariableLookup.parse(rebuilt_segments.join("."))
        elsif prepared_left.include?("[")
          left_operand = Liquid::VariableLookup.parse(prepared_left)
        else
          left_operand = Liquid::VariableLookup.parse(prepared_left)
        end

        operator = parser.consume?(:comparison)
        if operator
          resolved_operator = operator
          if condition_operator_kind(operator) == :comparison
            resolved_operator = canonical_condition_operator(operator)
          end
          right_markup = parser.expression
          prepared_right = Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_lookup_markup(right_markup)
          right_kind = Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_fragment_kind(prepared_right)
          right_operand = nil
          if right_kind == :literal
            right_operand = Liquid::Expression::LITERALS[prepared_right]
          elsif right_kind == :quoted
            if prepared_right.start_with?("'")
              prepared_right =~ Liquid::Expression::SINGLE_QUOTED_STRING
              right_operand = Regexp.last_match(1)
            else
              prepared_right =~ Liquid::Expression::DOUBLE_QUOTED_STRING
              right_operand = Regexp.last_match(1)
            end
          elsif right_kind == :integer
            if prepared_right.start_with?("-")
              prepared_right =~ Liquid::Expression::INTEGERS_REGEX
              right_operand = Regexp.last_match(1).to_i
            else
              prepared_right =~ Liquid::Expression::INTEGERS_REGEX
              right_operand = Regexp.last_match(1).to_i
            end
          elsif right_kind == :range
            prepared_right =~ Liquid::Expression::RANGES_REGEX
            range_start = Regexp.last_match(1)
            range_end = Regexp.last_match(2)
            start_markup = range_start
            end_markup = range_end
            if Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_fragment_kind(range_start) == :identifier
              start_markup = Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_lookup_markup(range_start)
            end
            if Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_fragment_kind(range_end) == :identifier
              end_markup = Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.condition_lookup_markup(range_end)
            end
            right_operand = Liquid::RangeLookup.parse(start_markup, end_markup)
          elsif right_kind == :float
            if prepared_right.start_with?("-")
              prepared_right =~ Liquid::Expression::FLOATS_REGEX
              right_operand = Regexp.last_match(1).to_f
            else
              prepared_right =~ Liquid::Expression::FLOATS_REGEX
              right_operand = Regexp.last_match(1).to_f
            end
          elsif prepared_right.include?(".")
            segments = prepared_right.split(".")
            rebuilt_segments = []
            index = 0
            while index < segments.length
              segment = segments[index]
              if index.zero?
                rebuilt_segments << Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.canonical_condition_token(segment)
              else
                if segment.include?("[")
                  rebuilt_segments << Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.canonical_condition_token(segment)
                else
                  rebuilt_segments << Jekyll::LiquidExtensions.canonical_condition_token(segment)
                end
              end
              index += 1
            end
            right_operand = Liquid::VariableLookup.parse(rebuilt_segments.join("."))
          else
            right_operand = Liquid::Expression.parse(prepared_right)
          end
          Liquid::Condition.new(left_operand, resolved_operator, right_operand)
        else
          Liquid::Condition.new(left_operand)
        end
      end

      condition = parse_one_comparison.call
      first_condition = condition
      binary_operator = parser.id?("and") || parser.id?("or")
      if binary_operator
        resolved_binary = binary_operator
        if condition_operator_kind(binary_operator) == :boolean
          resolved_binary = canonical_condition_operator(binary_operator)
        end
        child_condition = parse_one_comparison.call
        condition.send(resolved_binary, child_condition)
        condition = child_condition
      end
      first_condition
    end

    # Generates a Liquid::Condition object from a Liquid::Parser object based on whether the parsed
    # expression involves a "comparison" operator (e.g. <, ==, >, !=, etc)
    #
    #  - parser: an instance of Liquid::Parser
    #
    # Returns an instance of Liquid::Condition
    def parse_comparison(parser)
      left_operand = Liquid::Expression.parse(parser.expression)
      operator     = parser.consume?(:comparison)

      # No comparison-operator detected. Initialize a Liquid::Condition using only left operand
      return Liquid::Condition.new(left_operand) unless operator

      # Parse what remained after extracting the left operand and the `:comparison` operator
      # and initialize a Liquid::Condition object using the operands and the comparison-operator
      Liquid::Condition.new(left_operand, operator, Liquid::Expression.parse(parser.expression))
    end
  end
